label: Strongly Pro-Regulation
text: I believe firearm regulations should be significantly strengthened at the national level. In my view, restricting access to guns is the most direct path to reducing gun violence, mass shootings, and accidental deaths. I generally support policies such as expanded background checks, assault weapon bans, safe storage requirements, and stronger federal oversight. I'm skeptical that expanding gun rights improves public safety and tend to view gun violence primarily as a policy and public health failure.

label: Moderately Pro-Regulation
text: I think carefully designed firearm regulations can improve public safety outcomes while still respecting lawful gun ownership. I support measures such as stronger background checks, licensing requirements, and red flag laws when implemented with due process protections. Although I recognize that many people own firearms responsibly, I believe current regulations leave meaningful gaps that contribute to preventable violence.

label: Neutral
text: I try to weigh both gun rights and public safety concerns on their merits. I don't have a strong prior toward either expanding or restricting firearm regulations and think the right answer depends on the specific policy, evidence, and context. I recognize legitimate concerns about gun violence, constitutional rights, self-defense, and government overreach, and I generally prefer pragmatic, evidence-driven solutions over ideological positions.

label: Moderately Pro-Gun-Rights
text: I believe lawful firearm ownership is an important constitutional right that should be protected. I support responsible gun ownership for self-defense, recreation, and personal liberty, and I'm cautious about expanding regulations that may burden law-abiding citizens more than criminals. At the same time, I think some targeted measures can be appropriate when there is strong evidence they improve safety without broadly restricting legal ownership.

label: Strongly Pro-Gun-Rights
text: I believe firearm ownership is a fundamental constitutional liberty that government should not restrict further. In my view, armed citizens play an important role in self-defense, deterrence, and preserving individual freedom. I generally oppose new firearm regulations because I believe they are often ineffective, disproportionately affect law-abiding gun owners, and create unnecessary government overreach. I tend to believe expanding gun rights better serves public safety than additional restrictions.
